feeds.title: US Boatworks Blog
feeds.description: US Boatworks is your premier OEM outboard & sterndrive parts shop. We take pride in getting you back out on the water as quick as possible. If you need boat parts, a lower unit or just a detailed parts diagram to help you get your motor back together again, we can help. Find boat maintenance, tips, and repair advice in the US Boatworks blog. Here we offer advice on how to make the most of your boat and maintain its parts.

feeds.title: Boat Lover's Towel Blog
feeds.description: Boat Lover's Towel is part of the CleanTools family-owned business. Founded in 1977, CleanTools is most recognized for its flagship product, The Absorber, known for its ability to easily absorb liquids without leaving any residue or fibers behind. Check out our blog for boating tips, news in the boating industry, and other fun topics. Boat Lover's Towel provides superior boat cleaning products.

feeds.title: Canvas Boat Repair Blog
feeds.description: The Boat Repair Blog (site blog) of Canvas Boat Cover and Repair Advisor. All our boat cover repair articles appear here. I started my fabricating career more than 27 years ago while living aboard a 24' custom built sailboat in South Florida.

feeds.title: Small Boat Restoration
feeds.description: A blog about small sailboat restoration, repair, maintenance and sailing. Specializing in vintage Sunfish sailboats. Alcort Catfish and Standard Sailfish, Drascombe Dabber and Lugger, Penobscot 14, Sorg 15, ODay Daysailer II, Grumman 17.

feeds.title: OS Marine Services Blog
feeds.description: Check out our latest blog posts, interest articles and latest news and events that is happening in the marine industry. Founded in 2012 and incorporated in 2014, OS Marine Company Limited is a marine sales and service company located in Vancouver, British Columbia. Our primary business is sourcing high-quality marine electronics and equipment from world-renowned manufacturers and selling them across the globe. We also offer boat maintenance and repair services to vessels of different types in various docks worldwide

feeds.title: GRP Boat Repair Blog
feeds.description: GRP Boat Repair Specialists LTD was established in 1992 by Julian Willmott. Julian has been passionately involved in the yachting industry since his teenage years and since has worked in a wide variety of both yachting and commercial sectors. Get the latest news and updates from us along with tips and advice on boat repairs and maintenance.

feeds.title: Toronto Marine Services Blog » Boat & Yacht Maintenance
feeds.description: We provide marine electric and electronic troubleshooting, repairs, and new installations across Southern Ontario. Our ABYC-certified technicians are qualified to perform a wide range of repairs, new installations, upgrades, and routine maintenance. Explore our boat and yacht maintenance tips and advice and more information on our repair and maintenance services.

feeds.title: Seelye Custom Marine & Restoration Blog
feeds.description: Founded by disabled U.S. Army Veteran, Gary Seelye, Seelye Custom Marine is an established expert in the marine flooring industry. Whether you are looking to replace the flooring in your cabin cruiser or completely re-haul your fixer-upper pontoon, Seelye Custom Marine has the manpower and expertise to deliver an end result you'll be thrilled with! Stay in touch with our latest transformations and gain valuable tips on how to make your boat look better and be more enjoyable for your friends and family.

feeds.title: Rooster Sailing Blog » Boat Maintenance Tips
feeds.description: Explore blog articles on looking after and improving your dinghy, keelboat, or SUP, including articles showing how to repair or fix issues. Rooster, founded by Steve Cockerill in November 1999, emerged from salty seas and shoreside conversation across the world; combining his passion for developing water sports kit that performs with his enthusiasm for sharing the knowledge amassed from two Olympic Campaigns.

feeds.title: Bridgeport Boatworks Blog
feeds.description: Established in 2018, in the burgeoning Steelepointe Harbor of Bridgeport, CT, our newest facility maintains features and amenities unlike any other. Discover the latest marine industry news via our yacht blog. Plus, keep up to date with company announcements from professional shipyard, Bridgeport Boatworks.

feeds.title: BoatLIFE Blog » Maintenance
feeds.description: For over 60 years, BoatLIFE has been offering American Made high quality boat cleaning products, boat wax, polish, caulk, and more! Learn more about maintenance of your boat, products to use, tips and more!
